name: Event e Ikou! Sono 5
original_name: イベントへ行こう!その5
source:
Go to a convention, and have sex with a cosplayer!
A must-see girl who becomes your favorite character, as though she's coming out of the product to you!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ072703.html]DLsite[/url]]

Features [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chun-Li]Chun-Li[/url] from Street Fighter.
translation:
去漫展和cosplayer做爱吧！化身为心仪角色的女孩们，仿佛从作品中走出来一样，不容错过！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ072703.html]DLsite[/url]]

收录了《街头霸王》中的[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chun-Li]春丽[/url]。
